edits.prompt: Edit this black leech illustration. Keep slim black dubbed body, short marabou tail, matte watercolor white background. Replace downward hook with ONE continuous hook curving UP at left rear end of body, point facing RIGHT. Hook eye, shank and bend are one piece; no extra hardware.

Correct ONLY hook location on this crayfish fly. The hook bend currently floats halfway along upper rabbit claw; remove it there completely. Place ONE short hook bend emerging UP directly at LEFT END OF THE DUBBED BODY, where the two fur claws attach. Point faces RIGHT back toward body. The hook shank is entirely inside the dubbed body and connects to rightmost tie eye. Neither claw contains any hook. Preserve two rabbit claws, fine antennae, dubbed ribbed body, legs, right-end dumbbell, white background and watercolor style.
